How this list is built: every place comes from an official register or the institute's own website, and local places carry a Source link to the public page we checked; nothing is ranked. State pages exist with 3+ places and city pages with 10+. Spotted a mistake? Tell us.

Official sources & verification

Where these listings come from

Read on 2026-10-30. AICTE's approved-institutes dashboard refused every connection on 30 Oct 2026, so states without a readable counselling register (Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Haryana, Punjab, Odisha and others) show only the IITs, NITs and other institutes checked on their own websites. Ownership is shown only where the register states it; many Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh rows have none. Fees are not listed: each state's counselling authority publishes them every year (use the Counselling button).

  1. State CET Cell, Maharashtra — FE (B.E./B.Tech) CAP 2026 institute list (opens in a new tab) 380 institutes with address, district, status, branches and 2026-27 intake (each institute's summary page), read 2026-10-30.
  2. Karnataka Examinations Authority — UGCET 2026 engineering cut-off lists (opens in a new tab) Round-2 lists (rest of Karnataka, Hyderabad-Karnataka, special): every college KEA allotted engineering seats in, with address and branches.
  3. Anna University — district-wise list of affiliated colleges (opens in a new tab) Colleges with a TNEA counselling code (they fill B.E./B.Tech seats through TNEA); architecture and management-only schools left out.
  4. TGEAPCET (DTE Telangana) — institute-wise courses offered (opens in a new tab) Code, institute, place, district and type of every college in TG EAPCET counselling.
  5. UPTAC 2026 (AKTU) — institute list and cut-off matrix (opens in a new tab) Institutes kept only when their cut-off matrix has B.Tech seats; branches come from that matrix.
  6. ACPC Gujarat — Provisional GUJCET seat matrix for B.E. 2026-27 (opens in a new tab) Name, address, website, branches and management (Government / grant-in-aid / other) of every institute, dated 21.06.2026.
  7. CEE Kerala — KEAM 2026 prospectus, Annexure II (1)(a) (opens in a new tab) Colleges under engineering courses with code, university, branches and management; architecture colleges left out.
  8. Institute websites (IITs, NITs, IIITs and other institutes outside these registers) (opens in a new tab) Each checked on its own website; JoSAA fills IIT, NIT, IIIT and GFTI seats.
  9. Coaching brands' official centre locators and branch pages Each JEE centre links to its own branch page or the brand's official list of centres.
